do.name: Medieval Old Town and Street of the Knights
do.detail: A World Heritage site and one of the best preserved walled towns in Europe. The Street of the Knights runs from the Palace of the Grand Master at one end to the Hospital of the Knights, now the archaeological museum, at the other.

do.name: Lindos acropolis and St Paul's Bay
do.detail: Climb through the whitewashed village to the clifftop Athena Lindia temple, then swim in the enclosed bay below.

do.name: Valley of the Butterflies
do.detail: Shaded stream valley where Jersey tiger moths mass in summer; boardwalk paths climb between pools and plane trees.

do.name: Swim at Tsambika and Anthony Quinn Bay
do.detail: East coast pair: Tsambika's long shallow sands under a hilltop monastery, and a pebble snorkel cove of turquoise water.

do.name: Mandraki harbour
do.detail: Just outside the walls, with the two deer on their columns where the Colossus is supposed to have stood, and the windmills along the mole.

do.name: Day trip by boat to Symi
do.detail: Ferries and tour boats cross to Symi's amphitheatre of neoclassical houses for a harbour lunch of local shrimp.

do.name: Seven Springs forest walk
do.detail: Epta Piges: a cool wooded valley with streams, peacocks and a narrow tunnel walk to a small reservoir.

do.name: Wine and honey tasting around Embonas
do.detail: Vineyard villages on the Attavyros slopes pour the island's wines with local honey and cheese between tastings.
